home.action.reportArea.detail: Share real-time water levels, submerged access roads, bridge breaches, and stranded citizen headcounts.

home.action.requestRelief.detail: Request urgent food rations, clean drinking water, infant baby formula, medicines, or tarpaulin shelter kits.
